posts.title: Books and Specs I enjoyed reading
posts.description: I love reading. I’ve read many books and specs, so much so that I’ve lost count and track of everything I’ve read. As I’m getting into the rhythm of writing on this blog, I thought I would share some of my favorite books and specs I’ve read over the years. Books Books are my favorite way of learning new subjects. Here are some that I remember and liked reading: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces

posts.title: I don't want to be a spectator
posts.description: The ENIAC was designed and built while my grandfather was still a young man running through the woods of Inhambane. Rockets landed on the moon a few years before my father and mother came into this world. The internet was created before my father and mother met. The dotcom era started right around the time my father and mother had their 3rd child. All of this was way before I was born. I was welco

posts.title: Educated to use, not to create
posts.description: I’ve recently decided to write my own operating system. This is the hardest project I’ve ever attempted, and it has made me question what my education prepared me for. The first step in the journey of writing an OS is getting the computer to load your code and display some text on the screen. That alone is hard.
